rebuttal_or_critique: While I acknowledge the diverse perspectives within the committee, particularly the concerns regarding the real interest rate and the supply-side nature of food inflation, I must emphasize that our primary mandate is the durability of inflation alignment with the 4.00% target. Headline CPI at 4.75% remains uncomfortably above our target, and the persistence of food inflation at 8.69% poses a tangible risk to the anchoring of inflation expectations. Given the positive output gap of 0.40% and robust GVA growth of 6.80%, the economy has the resilience to withstand the current policy stance. A premature shift in stance or a rate cut could be misread as a dilution of our commitment to price stability. Therefore, I hold my ground on maintaining the status quo to ensure that inflation expectations remain firmly anchored as we navigate global uncertainties.
